working_definition: Post-mitotic female germ cells of early 16-cell cysts in the adult ovary (Li et al. 2022, Manual Annotation; broad class female germline cell).

best_match.fbbt_term: cyst cell of female germline 16-cell cyst
best_match.fbbt_definition: One of the 16 cyst cells that make up a female germline 16-cell cyst, resulting from the fourth and last round of cystoblast division (Hinnant et al., 2020).

justification: Cells of an early 16-cell cyst after the last mitotic division are the cyst cells of the 16-cell cyst; FBbt has no finer 'early'/post-mitotic term.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Cell that develops into or is itself an egg.
Cyst cell that will develop into a nurse cell. In the 16-cell cyst, these are the 15 cells that do not develop into the oocyte.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Only 15 of 16 cells; label does not distinguish.
